title: A faster switch for a first home lab
summary: Don't buy a switch to start. When file copies crawl, TL-SG108S-M2 is the quiet 2.5G default.

start.body: You don't need a new switch to start. Plug the old laptop into the router you already have. Buy a faster switch later, if file copies actually crawl.

choices.label: Still on the router / gigabit is fine

wait.body: Stay put. 2.5G still uses cables you already have. Most first labs stall because one old switch is the bottleneck — when that day comes, come back.

pick.body: Those extra-fast ports are 2.5G — a bit more than twice gigabit. Start here, worry about 10G later.

choices.label: I need VLANs or 10G to the NAS

tplink.body: TP-Link TL-SG108S-M2: 8× 2.5G, fanless, unmanaged. MSRP ~$80; sale streets lower. Skip no-name 5-ports with one fast port and four leftovers.

trendnet.body: TRENDnet TEG-S380: 8× 2.5G, fanless, NDAA/TAA, lifetime warranty. List ~$88; street often $74–80.

managed.body: TRENDnet TEG-3102WS: 8× 2.5G + 2× 10G SFP+, managed, fanless. About $200. Only if you need VLANs or a 10G DAC to the NAS.
